notes: granite-speech-5.0-2b_ekv2048.litertlm of litert-community/granite-speech-5.0-2b: the same source with the audio encoder rewritten for the GPU (24-second windows) and a 2,048-token context; its two language-model sections are the same bytes as the r5 candidate file; added 2026-11-07 (Hub commit be28d417); main 53f901f0 at the read, 2824395760 B, sha256 bf8eb5a8075b4fd3cdb1109a9edf0c247ff2bfb52b95699c31626aae80f3a642. Measured 2026-11-07 in the runs r7 (holds s26a, s26b: the card's Performance table; s26d: the source card's sample; s26e: the thread-count session and the LM bench) and r8 (hold s8mt: thread_count 6 against 8; hold s8x: re-timed against an unpublished NPU-encoder build, the 1.32 s of the card's Limitations). In hold s26e the LM bench also ran at thread_count=6 (runs u1w24-cpu-t6a / t6b: 229.42 / 14.855 tok/s); a record's identity is accelerator x prefill tokens, so only the default-thread bench is entered. The Galaxy S26 GPU LM bench was run on the r5 candidate (other bytes, the same two LM sections) and is not entered.
quantization: language model: int8 weights with one scale per output channel, KV cache 2,048 tokens, prefill signatures 64, 256 and 1,024 tokens, no activation-type declaration (float16 activations on the GPU, the runtime's default); token embedding table int8; audio encoder rewritten in operations the GPU accepts (tensors of rank 4 or less, no GATHER_ND): float16 weights computed in float32, one 24-second window; model type generic_model
